tech.summary: Elon Musk ne X par elaan kiya ke Tesla Cybertruck ki production 2027 ke darmiyan mein band kar dega — Giga Texas ki jagah do-seater Cybercab robotaxis banengi. 2019 mein unveil hone wala truck kabhi wada poora na kar saka: 2023 mein launch ke baad kul sirf dasiyon hazaar beche, 2025 mein US mein 20,237 — 2024 se 48% kam. Is se pehle Model S aur Model X bhi band ho chuke hain, un ki jagah Optimus robots ban rahe hain. Tesla ab car company se AI aur robotics company banne ki taraf tezi se ja rahi hai.
tech.title: Tesla ne Cybertruck ko khatam kar diya — factory ab robotaxis banayegi

tech.summary: The Information ki report ke mutabiq Nvidia ne private equity firm Apollo se baat ki hai ke us ki Brightspeed ki 130 se zyada purani telecom buildings ko chhote AI data centers mein badal diya jaye — 20 US states mein, taqreeban 1 gigawatt bijli ke saath. Retroﬁts 2027 ki pehli timaahi se Vera Rubin servers ke saath shuru ho sakte hain. Maqsad: naye data centers par local moratoriums aur mukhalfat se bachna, kyun ke purani buildings mein bijli, ﬁber aur zoning pehle se maujood hai. Abhi ye sirf proposal hai — koi ﬁnal deal nahi hui.
tech.title: Nvidia ki nayi chaal — purani telephone buildings ko AI data center banao

tech.summary: Reuters ki 6 November ki report ke mutabiq OpenAI ne apne naye funding round ka pehla hissa band kar liya: $11 billion, $1.25 trillion valuation par. Ye original $30 billion target ka sirf ek hissa hai — valuation pehle $1.4 trillion se gir kar $1.25 trillion hui, aur SoftBank aur UAE ke MGX ne hissa liya. AI market mein thand ka asar saaf hai: Anthropic ke expected IPO ki valuation bhi $2 trillion se gir kar $1.5 trillion ke aas-paas aayi hai. OpenAI ko compute ke liye paisa chahiye, lekin investors ab purani qeematein dene ko tayyar nahi.
tech.title: OpenAI ko $11 billion mil gaye — lekin valuation $1.25 trillion par atki

tech.summary: Thinking Machines Lab ne 5 November ko Inkling 2 Small launch kiya — 594 billion total parameters wala MoE model, har token par 17 billion active, jo Artificial Analysis ke Intelligence Index par 31 score karta hai, aur enterprise benchmark CoreCraft par 71.8%. Model abhi sirf Tinker platform par inference aur fine-tuning ke liye hai — weights agle hafte Apache 2.0 ke under aane ki umeed hai, lekin external safety testing mukammal hone par. Pehli generation se do guna bara, aur lambe autonomous kaam ke liye banaya gaya hai.
tech.title: Mira Murati ka Inkling 2 Small — 594 billion parameters, weights abhi bhi band

tech.summary: Meta ne 5 November se US mein Muse app par real-time voice calls aur avatar video chats roll out kar diye — mobile, web aur Mac par, 18 saal se zyada umar ke users ke liye. Muse Realtime Voice aur Realtime Avatar se avatar aap ki awaz sun kar expressions aur gestures banata hai — camera aap ko nahi dekhta, sirf awaz se kaam chalta hai. Jawab taqreeban 870 milliseconds mein aata hai, aur ek Nvidia GB200 GPU par 12 live sessions chal sakte hain. Agla qadam: AI glasses aur is saal aane wala Muse Charm pocket device.
tech.title: Meta ka Muse ab aap se video call par baat karega — avatar ke saath

tech.summary: Dropbox ne cloud storage startup Tigris Data ko taqreeban $350 million cash mein khareedne ka agreement kiya hai — ye company ki ab tak ki sab se bari acquisition hai, aur deal 2026 ki aakhri timaahi mein close hone ki umeed hai. Saath hi DBX Agent Cloud launch kiya gaya — AI developers ke liye S3-compatible object storage, jo aage chal kar filesystem aur content-processing bhi dega. Tigris ex-Uber engineers ne banayi thi aur us ne Series A mein $25 million uthaye the. Dropbox ab sirf file storage nahi, AI infrastructure bechna chahta hai.
tech.title: Dropbox ne $350 million mein Tigris khareeda — AI storage ki race mein bara daav

pakistan.summary: Wazir-e-Azam Shehbaz Sharif ne jumme ko hukam diya ke 100% digital payments system ke liye clear roadmap — timelines aur targets ke saath — pesh kiya jaye. Raast QR Code system ke zariye dukaan-daar aur customer ke darmiyan digital payments barhaye jaayenge, aur hukoomati idaron ki payments December 2026 tak mukammal digitize karne ka hadaf hai. BISP ki 100% payments ab digital wallets se ho rahi hain. 15 November se Easy Assignment Accounts mein cheque band, 16 November se sirf Raast.
pakistan.title: PM ka cashless Pakistan plan — 100% digital payments ka roadmap manga

pakistan.summary: IBA Karachi ki do-roza conference 'Beyond Polycrisis' ke ikhtitam par Climate Minister Musadik Malik ne kaha ke climate disasters, tech disruption aur ghair-barabar global economic order mil kar Pakistan ki kamzoriyan gehra kar rahe hain — paanch bade floods mein taqreeban 6,000 amwaat, 20,000 zakhmi aur 3-4 crore log beghar hue. Senator Sherry Rehman ne kaha ke duniya 'Axial Age' mein dakhil ho rahi hai jahan climate, AI aur geopolitics ek saath badal rahe hain, aur Pakistan 'recovery trap' mein hai — agla disaster pehle se theek hone se pehle aa jata hai. Abadi 25 crore se 2030 tak 27 crore hone ki peshgoi hai.
pakistan.title: Climate, AI aur maeeshat — IBA moot mein Pakistan ke 'polycrisis' par warning

pakistan.summary: Commerce Minister Jam Kamal ne Istanbul mein 42nd COMCEC Ministerial Session ke ikhtitami ijlas mein OIC mumalik ke darmiyan mazboot maashi yakjehti, behtar trade financing aur intra-OIC trade barhane ki appeal ki. Unhon ne kaha ke geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions aur protectionism ne mushtarka kaam ko pehle se zyada zaroori bana diya hai. Session mein trade, transport connectivity, food security, poverty alleviation aur digital transformation ko tarjeehi shobay qarar diya gaya — khaas taur par chhote exporters (MSMEs) ko sasti financing ki zaroorat par zor diya gaya.
pakistan.title: Pakistan ne OIC se maashi yakjehti aur behtar trade financing mangi

pakistan.summary: State Bank of Pakistan ne US tech company Cisco ke saath apna naya core banking network aur software-defined data centre deploy kar liya — ek multimillion-dollar project jo Pakistan ki financial infrastructure ko modernize karega. US Chargé d'Affaires Natalie Baker ne SBP Governor Jameel Ahmad aur Cisco Pakistan ke senior executives ke saath SBP headquarters mein is ka iftitah mark kiya. Project baghair kisi rukawat ke complete hua, jab ke central banking operations musalsal chalte rahe.
pakistan.title: SBP aur Cisco ka bara project — Pakistan ki banking ka naya digital backbone

pakistan.summary: PCB aur Abu Dhabi T10 League organisers ke darmiyan $200,000 tak ki compensation aur facilities par agreement ho gaya, jis se 16 Pakistani cricketers — jin mein Naseem Shah, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Amir aur Fakhar Zaman shamil hain — 7 November se shuru hone wale tournament mein khel sakenge. Tanaza is par tha ke PCB ne har NOC ke liye $10,000 manga tha, jab ke draft 30 September ko ho chuka tha. Ye sulah Geo News ki report ke mutabiq hui hai — lekin abhi tak har khiladi ka individual NOC jaari hone ki tasdeeq nahi hui.
pakistan.title: PCB aur Abu Dhabi T10 mein sulah — 16 Pakistani stars khel sakenge

pakistan.summary: Sri Lanka ne PCB Patrons XI ko Islamabad Club Oval mein teen-din ke warm-up match mein 142 runs se shikast de di — 254 runs ka target, Patrons XI sirf 111 par all out. Keshara Nuwantha ne 4 wickets liye, Eshan Malinga ne 3. Pakistan ne apne 14-rukni Test squad mein chaar izafi khiladiyon — Ubaid Shah, Ali Shabbir, Saqib Khan aur Tayyab Arif — ko shamil karne par ghaur shuru kar diya hai. Do-match Test series 9 November se Rawalpindi mein shuru hogi, jo ICC World Test Championship ka hissa hai.
pakistan.title: Sri Lanka ne warm-up mein Pakistan ko 142 runs se hara diya — Test se pehle warning
